entities.name: Query protein 416 aa
observations: Sequence is 416 aa; estimated mass 45.18 kDa and theoretical pI 5.63.
Strong homologs are reviewed bacterial pyrophosphate-dependent phosphofructokinases (PPi-PFK; EC 2.7.1.90), with 41.4–45.1% identity and 97.8–98.8% query coverage.
PFK family domain PF00365 detected at residues 10–309.

Function inferred by homology: catalyzes fructose-6-phosphate + diphosphate ⇌ fructose-1,6-bisphosphate + phosphate; likely Mg2+-dependent, cytoplasmic and homodimeric. Exact identity, organism, and experimental function are not established for this query.

entities.name: Pyrophosphate-dependent phosphofructokinase
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs annotate EC 2.7.1.90, Rhea RHEA:13613; use inorganic pyrophosphate rather than ATP as phosphate donor and can support glycolysis and gluconeogenesis.
Reviewed reference annotations report Mg2+ cofactor, cytoplasmic localization, and homodimeric subunit structure; these are homolog-derived, not experimentally established for the query.
